info.description: The /v1 contract shared by the web app, native clients and integrations. Changes within v1 are additive only.

post.description: Runs one mutation envelope (TS-20) and answers with its outcome (TS-27). Sending the same `mutationId` again returns the stored outcome without running it twice (TS-22).
